raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "1.1" %}
{% set build = 8 %}
{% set mpi = mpi or "nompi" %}

package:
  name: gauxc
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  - url: https://github.com/wavefunction91/gauxc/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 17de077fb23e44d03b0ed14dcd8117c01e5b3431fbefa2352d751639ada7f91c
    patches:
      - patches/gh-161.patch  # Allow finding highfive library
      - patches/gauxc-cuda-config.patch  # Allow linking against only CUDAToolkit
  - url: https://github.com/wavefunction91/linalg-cmake-modules/archive/9d2c273a671d6811e9fd432f6a4fa3d915b144b8.tar.gz
    sha256: 6e49c6c7c7df14b956d1fee77d9b6aad9ded3210cd639133c69a52b2e5ce4eae
    folder: external/linalg-cmake-modules

{% if mpi == "nompi" %}
{% set build = build + 100 %}
{% endif %}
build:
  number: {{ build }}
  skip: true  # [win]

  string: cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}_{{ mpi_prefix }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ build }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  string: cpu_{{ mpi_prefix }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ build }}  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]

  run_exports:
    # linter gives false positive about gauxc not a subpackage, but multi-line separation of version & bldstring
    #    has its own bug consolidating at consumption-time (invalid character ^). Live with the lint
    - {{ pin_subpackage("gauxc", max_pin='x.x') }} cpu_{{ mpi_prefix }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
    - {{ pin_subpackage("gauxc", max_pin='x.x') }} cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}_{{ mpi_prefix }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  ignore_run_exports:
    - catch2

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ compiler('cuda') }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake >3.20,<4
    - ninja
    - llvm-openmp  # [osx]
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - exchcxx >=1.0,<2 cpu_*  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
    - exchcxx >=1.0,<2 cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - gau2grid >=2.0.6,<3
    - hdf5 * {{ mpi_prefix }}_*
    - highfive >=2.4.1,<3
    - integratorxx >=1.0,<2
    - libblas  # [linux]
    - libgomp  # [linux]
    - llvm-openmp  # [osx]
    - libmagma-devel   # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcublas-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcusparse-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-cudart-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - {{ mpi }}  # [mpi != "nompi"]
  run:
    - llvm-openmp  # [osx]
    - {{ mpi }}  # [mpi != "nompi"]
    - __cuda  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]

test:
  commands:
    - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgauxc$SHLIB_EXT  # [unix]

about:
  home: https://github.com/wavefunction91/gauxc
  summary: >-
     GauXC is a modern, modular C++ library for the evaluation of quantities related to
     the exchange-correlation (XC) energy (e.g. potential, etc) in the Gaussian basis set
     discretization of Kohn-Sham density function theory (KS-DFT) on heterogenous architectures.
  license: BSD-3-Clause and BSL-1.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt  # BSD-3-Clause
    - NOTICE.md
    - external/linalg-cmake-modules/LICENSE.txt  # BSD-3-Clause

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - awvwgk
